translations.description_clean:
This is a performance mod that mostly prevents the AI from causing the game to lag due to some of its actions, among other things. The mod gets the AI under control without affecting the gameplay of players and almost not affecting (as much as possible) the AI's gameplay.

⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀⠀https://i.imgur.com/fVVaDCS.gif⠀[url=https://www.paypal.com/donate/?hosted_button_id=3G6BLVZBHM4YS]https://i.imgur.com/1BWfuZR.png
What the mod does to effectively boost performance:

[*]Disable AI Hyper Relays: Stops the AI from constructing Hyper Relays as they degrade performance especially with their required amount (optional).

[*]Restrict AI Gateways: Stops the AI from constructing Gateways more than twice every 100 years to prevent the AI from building them too quickly, unnecessarily (optional and configurable).

[*]Disable AI Deep Space Citadels: stops the AI from building multiple Deep Space Citadels in every system as that can make navigating fleets in galaxy view annoying and blocking (optional).

[*]Modifier Updating Optimisation: Reduces the burden of updating modifiers by decreasing their update frequency to 3 times per month (optional).

[*]Disable AI Xeno-Compatibility: Stops the AI from getting Xeno-Compatibility ascension perk to prevent unnecessary hybrid species (optional).

[*]Disable AI Omnicodex Relic: Stops the AI from getting the Omnicodex Relic to prevent unnecessary hybrid species (optional and configurable).

[*]Restrict AI Ringworlds: Stops the AI from constructing ringworlds by introducing a limit of 3 ringworlds per AI (optional and configurable).

[*]Restrict AI Habitats: Stops the AI from constructing habitats by introducing a limit of 7 habitats per AI (optional and configurable).

[*]Restrict AI Sub-species: It limits the AI from creating large number of sub-species, limiting it to 2.

[*]Improve AI unemployment: Fills AI job vacancies faster and reduces unemployment by resettling the unemployed pops to planets with open jobs to prevent increased checking (optional).

[*]Restrict AI Corvettes/Frigates: Stops the AI from building corvettes, frigates, destroyers, and cruiser by putting a cap on corvettes and frigates to 60, destroyers to 30, and cruisers to 15 per fleet. Once the AI reaches the cap(s), a corvette is replaced with a frigate, and 2 frigates are replaced with a destroyer, and 2 destroyers are replaced with a cruiser, and 2 cruisers are replaced with a battleship. This should make AI fleets less corvette heavy and stronger (the 2 for 1 trade-off works out economically). This also allies to bio-ships and only occurs when possible e.g., when the AI has destroyer technology and cruiser technology for balance reasons (optional and configurable).

[*]Prevent AI micro-marketing: Prevents the AI from continuously market micro selling and buying small amounts when resource capacity is full.

[*]Restrict AI Eternal Vigilance: Prevents the AI from picking the full and half spending policy options from the Eternal Vigilance ascension perk (optional).

[*]Restrict AI Science/Construction Ships: Stops the AI from building science and construction ships by putting a cap of 6 (by default). Once the AI reaches the cap(s), it will not be able to build anymore which will reduce fleet pathing related performance hits if the ships are excessively built (optional and configurable).

[*]Improve AI fleet count: Prevents the AI from having multiple partly filled fleets and merges them when possible while not at war. This should also provide a relatively good performance boost (optional).

[*]Enable some AI opt on players: As a preference, you can enable some of the AI optimisations to be also applied on players for potential balance and further performance gains. These currently include (if not disabled); just 'Restrict AI Eternal Vigilance' (optional).

Most of the features listed above can be disabled or configured at game start if desired or through an edict during a game; using a custom UI for better accessibility.

Further tuning that can be done manually if needed:
- Lower habitable planets.
- Lower guaranteed planets.
- Disable Logistics Ship Cost (Can give more performance potentially but it's an unreliable option at the moment).

Latest update:
- The optimisation "Restrict AI Science/Construction Ships" has been added! It will stop the AI from building science and construction ships by putting a cap of 6 (by default). Once the AI reaches the cap(s), it will not be able to build anymore which will reduce fleet pathing related performance hits if the ships are excessively built (optional and configurable).
- General bug fixes (just kidding, everything is perfect of course haha).

I kind of ran out of UI space for more optimisations so in the next update I'll try to make room for more if needed haha

Future development:
- Construction ship and/or science ship limit.
- Look into pop groups and how they affect performance (if so, change migration policy for AI etc).

- If you think there is a problem with the AI that slows the game, don't hesitate to comment it below, pop it in the discussion, or let me know it the discord!

Additional information:
- Mostly compatible with current save game but some of the features will not work and will not break the game if enabled.
- Compatible with Glavius and Starnet mods.

This mod is an evolution of the [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1302974986]Space Battles mod, adapted for the new version of [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1887282318]System Scaling. This changes the radius of the battles and the speed of flights in the system, so that it would better correspond to the changed scale of the system.

When I started updating the Space Battles, I discovered a problem that I had not previously paid attention to. With an increase of 6 times, this became very noticeable. The fact is that with a proportional decrease in the range of the guns, the battles turned into a crazy ball of ships and flashes. Then I realized it was all about speed, which remained the same. After I reduced the speed of the ships in the system in proportion to the scaling, everything returned to normal. Space battles began to look wonderful again.

After update 1.1, these mods no longer reduce ship speed constantly. Although, in essence, they are still doing this, but with one important change. Now both modes globally slow down the flight speed of ships by 6 times, their difference is different.

I decided to add the concept of "cruising speed" to the game. This works as a significant increase in sublight speed when ships are not in combat. Thus, we solve the problem of slow and tedious flights and make space battles similar to those that were in the very first version of Stellaris. This method was suggested to me by Chickenhunt (author of [url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1878473679&searchtext=]Amazing Space Battles). Some settings for the behavior of the ship in battle have also been changed to fully combine with ASB (no longer needs a compatibility patch) and greater entertainment.

Changing the speed of ships will significantly affect the gameplay. So I decided to rename the Space Battles mod to Ships in Scaling. I divided the mod into 2 variations:


 [*][url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1915620447]Ships in Scaling Hard - “cruis acceleration” is a gameplay element and depends on the type of traster (sublight engine) used. This acceleration does not exceed 400%.
 [*]Ships in Scaling Lite (this version) - “cruis acceleration” is a passive modifier for all ships and increases the speed of sublight movement by 600%. Thus, global slowdown is fully compensated. Also in this version, the radius of ships entering the battle is increased.


I recommend trying both versions of the mod in order to decide for yourself which one is best for you.

translations.description_zh_current: 本 MOD（v1.7.6）兼容 3.8 Gemini 版本，是 Space Battles MOD 的进化版，适配新版 System Scaling（系统缩放）。作者在更新 Space Battles 时发现：系统放大 6 倍后，武器射程按比例缩短，但舰船速度未变，导致战斗变成一团乱麻。将舰船在系统内的速度按缩放比例降低后，太空战恢复了观赏性。MOD 引入「巡航速度」概念：非战斗时亚光速飞行速度显著提升，解决慢速航行拖沓的问题，同时让太空战重现群星最初版本的感觉。全局将舰船亚光速飞行速度降低 6 倍（两种模式下效果不同）。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 配合 System Scaling MOD 使用，调整战斗半径与舰船速度，获得更符合系统缩放尺度的太空战体验。适合追求真实尺度战斗的玩家。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 2.3 万、收藏 2686。这是《真实空间》系列作者基于 Space Battles 模组演变而来的舰船缩放模组，适配系统缩放玩法，通过调整战斗半径与飞行速度、引入巡航速度概念，使太空战更贴合缩放后的星系比例。作者自述在更新中发现并解决了速度比例问题。为 3.8 版本。作者未提供更多评价信息。
translations.features_zh_current: ["适配 System Scaling", "调整战斗半径与飞行速度", "引入「巡航速度」概念", "太空战更壮观"]

translations.summary_zh_current: 星球大战主题静态银河地图：900+ 星系，电影设定还原的星球位置与名字，3 个星战风格堕落帝国，支持自定义帝国生成。
translations.description_zh_current: 本 MOD 提供一张星球大战主题的静态银河地图（已更新至 1.4）：包含 900+ 星系，行星位置与命名符合电影设定，还原深核以及科里班、恩多、塔图因等经典星系；连接所有主要与次要超空间航线；包含奇斯空间与赫特空间；支持随机与自定义帝国生成；内置 3 个星战风格堕落帝国。已知问题：无高级 AI、随机 AI 会重命名星系（自定义帝国不受影响）、主星系可能刷出敌对太空生物、部分人口可能缺失思潮。建议仅超空间航线模式游玩，推荐搭配作者提供的配套 MOD 合集。

translations.description_clean:
游戏人生零机凯种种族mod
No Game No Life Zero Ex-Machina Species Mod

This mod is re-creation of 『No Game No Life』.
The star age storyline is based on the main timeline in 2200,Schwi's soul reunited on a Gaia planet in the galaxy with an elf corridor and rehuilded her race,searching for missing memories and important things.

Guide:This mod is an enhanced mod for Rogue Servitor,please make sure you have chosen Machine Intelligence authority,Rogue Servitor and Cutting-edge machinery civics or you will just add the portraits.

This MOD contains the following

1.Many Ex-Machina portraits.Many special leaders you can choose at the beginning of the game,new traits and special projects.

2.Five new civics,new origin,new edicts and ascension perks.

3.New technologies(ship weapon, ship part, building, hull tech etc)

4.New buildings, new strategic resource, new planet, new jobs, new megastructures.

5.New weapons.

6.New story events，new precursor event chain.

7.New relics

8.New flags

9. New spcaeship size: Starkiller, Dreadnought

10. New fallen empire: Fluegel fallen empire, new weapon technology system.

Caution:
1.This mod material is all from the Internet, and the painting copyright belongs to the painter.

2.New buildings need new planet to build. New spaceship need to complete the Elemental event chain

3.If any other conflicts occur, be sure to check by placing this mod at the bottom of the order.

4.This mod can be used by Ai.

5.Need more Ascension Slots? Click👉[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1890399946]UI+Overhual+Dynamic

6. New fallen empire may have compatibility problems with other mods which add or modify fallen empires in game. Please give me a feed back if you find problems. Please place this mod  after other specie mod like Warship Girls R and Nirvana etc in game launcher.

本mod为榎宫祐所著小说《游戏人生》第六卷及其动漫作品的二次创作mod。
讲述到游戏时间的2200年，休比小可爱的灵魂被传送到了一颗有精灵回廊的盖亚星球上复活，并在上面重建机凯种，寻回丢失的记忆和心，寻找里克灵魂的故事。

游玩指南：本mod本质上是失控机仆的加强mod，游玩本mod开局请务必选择格式塔思潮，智械帝国。公民性开局务必选机仆和神造机械（进入游戏后随着进度有四个新的公民性可选）否则就相当于只开了个物种头像。

本mod包含以下内容

1.多种机凯种族头像，多种颜色，生化陈设的头像选了小伊纲的（小伊纲太香了）。开局根据不同选择会有特殊特质领袖，新的种族特质，新的种族改造特殊项目。

2.新的5种公民性（一个必要，四个可选）新起源（剧情线请务必选择该起源）新的法令，新的飞升

3.新的科技树（包括舰船武器，组件科技，建筑科技，循环科技）

4.新的建筑，职业，新的战略资源，新星球，新巨构（解决机仆打仗越打越穷，后期二产转化乏力问题）

5.新的舰船武器与组件（较为强力）

6.新的故事事件, 新的先驱者事件链（目前只做了休比寻找里克的主线，以后会更新做做支线剧情，丰富主线剧情）

7.新的遗珍（只有在选择新的起源才能解锁，因为放到了主线故事事件中）

8.新的旗帜。

9.新舰船类型弑星者和无畏舰

10. 新的天翼种堕落帝国，新的武器科技系统（指抽卡）。

注意事项：

1.本mod所有图片来源于网络，立绘著作权归原画师所有。

2.本mod特色活体陈设建造只能建造在盖亚/精灵天穹，请在合适的时机点这一飞升（合成时代已禁用）。弑星者需要完成先驱者事件链开放建造

3.若出现问题，请将本mod置于最下层检查与其他mod的兼容

4.本mod种族可以给ai使用。

5.mod占用飞升槽较多，有需要请订阅：[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2458655721]63传统槽 + 64飞升槽

6. 新的堕落帝国可能与其他修改或添加堕落帝国的mod冲突，如有发现请在评论区联系我。请将本mod排序放置于舰Rmod和涅槃之后（如果你订阅了的话）

最新动态     Update

3.25 已适配游戏版本4.3（可能存在未修复BUG）

天翼种现已重新开放可选。目前内容较少，仅作先行测试用。

开发计划

-BUG修复/数值调整/飞升重置

-天翼种玩家帝国：战神陨落后，古老的战士失去存活的意义……漂流到这个河系的她们会经历怎样的奇遇，又如何重拾新生的希望呢？

translations.description_clean:
Have you ever noticed that primitive worlds have no unique names and just use the name of their star followed by a number?  While it's a minor detail, it's a bit lame and is somewhat immersion breaking. After all, what species  names their own planet with a number?

This simple mod makes it so all naturally-generated primitive worlds will have actual unique names taken from the primitives' namelists instead of the generic "STAR  NAME - PLANET NUMBER" format.

Does not affect primitives spawned after game start, and will not affect Gigastructural Engineering's custom primitives.
"Sol III" is always renamed to "Earth" if it has primitives.

Created after seeing u/SuperGeek29's reddit post on the topic found [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Stellaris/comments/u63ok9/is_there_a_mod_out_there_that_give_names_to/]here.

Will likely be compatible with every future version unless Paradox makes drastic changes to the scripting.

PSE extends the playstyle of Psionic Empire!

For Stellaris version 4.4+

------
Compatibility

namespace = pse
global_flag = has_pse_started


	[*]Not achievement compatible.
	[*]One vanilla file was edited: main_bottom.gui, any mods that alter it might cease the display of mini bar.


If you are using UI Overhaul Dynamic and looking for a patch of them, click [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3292155860]here.

------
Why does this mod appear?

Many people noticed that the psionic ascension, compared to the biological and the synthetic, is far inferior to the other two since 2.2.
One is population matters everything for resources, the other is psionic lacks of unique elements to play with, besides the RNG Shroud.

Here comes to mind: What if a psionic empire can use the power of its people to do something great that biological and synthetic cannot do?

Also, let's hope the upcoming DLC -Shadow of the Shroud - can really make the psionic FUN!
------
What does it do?

	[*]When your primary species display the sign of psionic, you gain access to cast the power of psionics.

	[*]New resource - Psionic Power, which generates a certain amount (and other factors) every month. Used to cast the Power.
The amount of Psionic Power you can hold heavily relies on your psionic pops, pops with telepath job, ruler and technologies.
	
	[*]There are 55 powers to cast, with 20 of them locked behind specific conditions. Each Power requires a different amount of Psionic Power to perform.
There could be more in the future but no guarantee - Powers need to be valuable and fun enough to play with.
	
	[*]Think twice before you recklessly cast the powers. Corruption grows by casting powers.
The only Power to reduce it is Purification, and you do not want that to go beyond the scale.

	[*]Zro plays an essential role, and you want them more in this mod! They can reduce the threshold of power, or use them to increase the production of psionic pops.
	
	[*]When your Ruler is the Chosen One, they can greatly aid their power for the empire.
These powers are exclusive for Chosen One and can only be performed with their help.

	[*]By forming the covenant with one of the Shroud entites, you gain access the related powers.

	[*]Add 10 new technologies, 3 edicts, all related to psionics.



------
Notices

	[*]Avoid using the psionic menu when operating other businesses like planetary view, commanding ships - as the UI mod checks whether the scope is country all the time.
It won't break the mod but will refuse to function until then.
	
	[*]You can have Psionic Power more than the bar can displays (300).

	[*]Hive Mind, Machine Empire may access the feature as long as they have Psionic traits, but such you need related mod to let that happen.
	
	[*]Lots of effort on AI, so they can handle the mod features without any drawback.
	
	[*]AI can access the Shroud properly with this mod. (Please ask Paradox to address this)
	
	[*]This mod mainly focuses on species with psionic power, not on buildings, structures, weapons or ships.

	[*]To gigastructure worshipers: Spirit Flame no longer forces delete fleets in the system they belong. Therefore, whoever blames Spirit Flame for deleting ships will be considered as a false claim.

	[*]If a psionic empire screws you up, you should have destroyed them a long ago.

translations.description_zh_current: 本 MOD（简称 PSE）扩展灵能帝国的玩法，针对群星 4.4+ 版本，需要乌托邦 DLC 解锁全部内容。作者指出自 2.2 以来灵能飞升相比基因与机械飞升明显弱势（机械靠人口产出资源，灵能缺乏独特可玩要素，只有看脸的虚境），因此设计了「灵能之力」系统：当主体物种展现灵能特质后，即可施放灵能法术。核心机制：新资源「灵能之力」（Psionic Power）每月按人口等因素产出，储量依赖灵能人口、心灵感应岗位、统治者与科技；共 55 种法术可施放，其中 20 种需特定条件解锁，每种消耗不同数量的灵能之力。注意：不兼容成就；修改了原版文件 main_bottom.gui（可能影响其他修改该文件的 MOD 的小型工具栏显示）。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 走灵能飞升路线后，通过灵能人口产出「灵能之力」，在 55 种法术中选择施放，从辅助帝国发展到战场决胜皆可。使用 UOD 时可搭配官方兼容补丁。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 3.5 万、收藏 4700。这是一款灵能帝国玩法扩展模组，作者自述起因是 2.2 以来灵能飞升相比生物与合成飞升明显偏弱、且缺乏独特内容，遂为灵能帝国新增灵能力资源、55 个可施放能力、专属职业与科技等内容。适配 4.4+，完整内容需乌托邦 DLC，不兼容成就。作者还希望后续 DLC「Shadow of the Shroud」能让灵能玩法更有趣。作者未提供更多评价信息。
translations.features_zh_current: ["新资源「灵能之力」", "55 种灵能法术（20 种需解锁）", "扩展灵能帝国玩法", "需要乌托邦 DLC 体验完整内容"]

New missions for Observation Posts and related events.

MISSIONS

We Are Your Gods
The natives are led to believe that you are their gods. You effectively enslave them from above.
Cannot be used by: fanatic spiritualists, fanatic xenophiles, xenophiles or fanatic pacifists. 
Can only be used on bronze age, iron age and late medieval primitives.

We Are Your Guardians
You actively aid and guide the natives, but you do not advance their technology. They are allowed to develop at their own rate and may ask you to leave at any time. (This doesn't mean you have to!)
Cannot be used by: fanatic spiritualists, fanatic xenophobes or fanatic authoritarians. Can be used by Machine Servitors.
Can only be used on renaissance age, steam age, industrial age, machine age, atomic age and early space age primitives.

The Q-Bricks
A number of complex and totally impenetrable devices are placed on the planet that monitor the behaviour of the natives and allow you to make small (sweeping/massive) adjustments to their evolutionary path and rate, as well as guide their overall development as sentient life-forms.
No ethics restrictions.
Has tech requirements, which will be shown when you mouse over.
Can only be used on stone age, bronze age and iron age primitives.

See the screenies above for more info on what the missions do and what the restrictions for use are.

DYNAMIC MISSION BUTTONS
If an Observation Mission isn't displayed, you don't have the ethics needed to use it. If it appears but is greyed out, hover the mouse over it and it will list the requirements.

Missions that can't be done in a particular instance will be removed in preference for missions that can be done.

There's now eight slots for buttons, thanks to UI work by subscriber 'Calamity'.

INDEPENDENT OBSERVATION
If you want to have missions with fewer ethical restrictions, use the empire edict shown in slide 2. Note that some costs and output are changed when you use this.

COMPATIBILITY

[*]common/observation_station_missions/00_missions.txt

[*]interface/fleet_view.gui
[*]interface/outliner.gfx

Works with v2.1 and v2.0.x.
Should be fine with an existing save-game.
Works with AlphaMod. Does not need AlphaMod. Is not included in AlphaMod.
Not Ironman achievement compatible.

translations.summary_zh_current: 为观测站新增三种任务与配套事件的旧版玩法 MOD，让原始文明观测增添神权、守护与监控的扮演路线。
translations.description_zh_current:
• 为观测站（Observation Post）新增任务及相关事件，共三大任务
• 『我们是你的神』：让土著相信你是神明，自上而下奴役他们；狂热唯心、狂热亲外、亲外与狂热和平主义不可用；仅限青铜、铁器与中世纪晚期原始文明
• 『我们是你的守护者』：积极援助并引导土著但不提升其科技，任其按自身节奏发展，土著也可能随时请你离开；狂热唯心、狂热仇外、狂热威权不可用，机器管家可用；仅限文艺复兴至早期太空时代
• 『Q 砖块』：在行星放置复杂且无法穿透的监控装置，监视土著并可对其进化路径与速率做出小/大/大规模调整；无伦理限制但有科技前置（悬停可查看）；仅限石器、青铜与铁器时代

• 『独立观测』帝国法令可用伦理限制更少的任务，但成本与产出会有变化
• 兼容性：修改原版观测站任务、舰队视图等 4 个文件；适用于游戏 2.0.x/2.1；可兼容既有存档；兼容 AlphaMod（无需其本体，也不包含于其中）；不兼容铁人成就
• 附西班牙语本地化（作者 Ensis）；页面含 PayPal/Patreon 赞助渠道
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 订阅启用后，在拥有原始文明的观测站任务列表中选择上述任务；按钮不显示说明伦理不符，灰色按钮悬停查看条件；想少受伦理限制可启用『独立观测』法令。

translations.title_zh_current: 脚本触发器底层库（Scripted Trigger Undercoat）
translations.summary_zh_current: 供其他 MOD 共用的底层框架：将大量原版硬编码触发器改写为可覆盖的脚本触发器与内联脚本，本身不改变玩法。
translations.description_zh_current:
• 面向 MOD 作者的基础库（Framework），本身不做任何事；把大量原版触发器替换为脚本触发器（部分原版、部分新增），供其他 MOD 直接覆盖扩展
• 主要改写：has_authority = auth_corporate → is_megacorp（ oligarchic 并列处除外）；has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness → is_gestalt；蜂巢/机器意志触发器化（政府判断除外）；国民理念 potential 块内联化（四类政府触发器）；has_origin/has_civic/has_valid_civic 收编为脚本触发器；贸易路线条件改为 can_have_trade_routes；is_country_type = default → is_playable/is_empire；is_planet_class = pc_city → is_city_planet 等
• 新增钩子：on_primitives_enter_space on_action；pop 战略资源维护内联脚本；pop 类别通用内联脚本；origin 可用国家旗帜跳过 game_start.12；次要物种起始 pop 脚本修正；首都建筑与栖息地修正内联脚本；job_groups 职业替换内联脚本（高等祭司/首席研究员、匠师替代工匠等）；@TRADITION_CATEGORIES_MAX 传统数量脚本变量；干/湿/冷宜居性静态修正；水生特质调整钩子；巨构建造预算旗帜；DLC 检测触发器补全；is_endgame_crisis 触发器等（完整清单见讨论区）
• 兼容性：覆盖大量内容，但作者期望其他 MOD 能适配本 MOD，因其自身无功能；另提供配合 Stellaris General Fixes 的替代版本
• 加载顺序：建议置于加载顺序最上层
• 更新提示：因覆盖文件多，每次游戏更新常会多处损坏；更新一般在一周内完成；当前版本未适配前请勿报具体 BUG（页面注明更新至 4.4.6）
• 开源仓库在 GitHub；作者征求更多收录建议
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 玩家无需单独配置，作为所依赖 MOD 的前置启用即可；多 MOD 叠加时按作者建议将其置于加载顺序顶端；游戏大版本更新后留意其是否已跟进适配。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 1.16 万、收藏 935。这是面向MOD作者的基础库，把大量原版触发器替换为脚本触发器，供其他MOD覆盖扩展。

translations.description_clean:
Features 

Adds cybernetic versions of humans, default humanoids and several other species portraits and applies them whenever a pop or leader of appropriate species receives a cybernetic trait. 

Leaders will preserve their original phenotype and colour after the portrait change. 

Affects both player and computer controlled empires. 

 Requirements 

Requires either Utopia or Synthetic Dawn DLC to unlock cyborgs feature. 

 Compatibility 

Save game compatible
Feel free to enable this mod after you've already completed the Flesh is Weak project or started a game as Driven Assimilators. It's even somewhat recommended. More on that bellow. 

Previous versions compatible
Confirmed to be working fine with 2.1. And it should work with even older versions unless they lack some of the affected portraits. Do not mind the warning at the game launch.

Beta version compatible
As long as the beta version does not affect portrait triggers mechanic, this mod is compatible with it. Once again you are free to ignore the warning at the launch of the game.

Achievements incompatible
As the mod uses triggers for changing species appearence and is not just a portrait replacer it's not suitable for getting achievements

Remastered Human Portraits compatibility
Deadrick, the author of Remastered Human Portraits, made this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1635637895]compatibility patch. It contains high quality cyber-human portraits and now you are more than recommended to use it.

Other mods compatibility
This mod modifies 09_portraits_humanoid and 07_portraits_human. Every other mod which affects these gamefiles will be in conflict with Visible Cyborgs. You may resolve the conflict by playing with your favourite replacer active and then switching to this mod after embracing cybernetics.

 Credits 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=687822601]Human Revolution by stallfish and Killorado - It has inspired me to work on Visible Cyborgs as well as provided valiable graphical assets without which this mod wouldn't be here.
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=933075365]Animated Synthetics Portraits by silfae - I've used a graphical asset from this mod to make a cyborg version of molluscoid_11. And I'm probably going to use more in later updates. 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198018262825/myworkshopfiles/?appid=281990]Deadrick - not only he created a compatibility patch but also provided valuable graphical assets which are going to help me make even more cybernetic species.

 Known Issues 

Sometimes the game engine forgets to update the appearence of the leader after they become cyborgs. That's a side effect of the method I use to preserve leaders phenotype. Save your game and then load it - the issue will be fixed. Alternatively, you may just enable the mod already after the completion of Flesh Is Weak special project.

In a very specific occasion, when you play custom made empire using human portrait your ruler may get wrong phenotype after becoming cyborg. In case you manage to get this problem. I've added special events viscyb.101 - viscyb.105 which changes the phenotype of your leader allowing you to get the right one.
 
 Future Plans 

I'm still working on the mod. More cybernetic versions of default species are going to be added soon. You may ask me to work with your favourite species in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/1618459811/1741105170035494367/]Suggestions discussion.

Version 1.5 for Stellaris 1.6 "Adams"

Fallen Empires are ancient, stagnating but extremely powerful empires, fully developed at the start of the game. They serve as late-game adversaries and can be allies or opponents of the end-game crisis, War in Heavens.

- [url=http://www.stellariswiki.com/Fallen_empire]Fallen Empires, Stellaris Wiki


Fallen Empires Expanded improves upon the current state of fallen empires in Stellaris 1.6 "Adams".

By adding new personalities types and attributes, this mod works to breath more diversity and character into fallen empires. More varieties of fallen empires will spawn along with their unique homewords and ethos-related colonies.

Due to the vast size of galaxies in Stellaris, it may take you a lengthy time to experience what this mod has to offer.

A new save game will be required to experience the best of Fallen Empire Expanded.

http://i.imgur.com/TVbRO8o.png

◢ Increase max # of Fallen Empires
Unmodded Stellaris can only support up to four fallen empires, even on largest galaxy presets.
Fallen Empires Expanded fixes this issue, overriding the artificial fallen empire limit. You can have up to 8 different fallen empires in one galaxy.
Enough to satisfy the staunchest of masochists. 

◢ No Clustered Start
Fallen Empires Expanded is fully integrated with [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=687226658]No Clustered Start with new galaxy options to utilize this feature. You can now play with 8+ fallen empires without the worry of being subjected to a galactic ぶっかけ from fallen empires spawned beside you!
No Clustered Start, created by Taw, works by spreading out the placement of empires uniformly throughout the galaxy. This is done through changes the default spawning parameters in Stellaris. 
Note: No compatibility issues will arise if both FEE and No Clustered Starts are subscribed.

◢ New Ethos for Fallen Empire
Additional ethics variants for fallen empires, each with its unique traits.
	[*] Fanatic Militarists
	[*] Hive Minds


◢ New Unique Fallen Empires
Prescripted fallen empires with predetermined ethos, species, and/or personalities.
	[*] Terran Coalition -  Earth-based Xenophile Human FE
	[*] Sol Imperium - Mars-based Alien Xenophobic FE
	[*] Azalthyn Hive - Hivemind FE	

◢ New Subject types of Fallen Empires
The more slaves the merrier.
	[*] Puppet States - Proxy expansionist empire for fanatic militarist FEs	
	[*] Levy States - Food slave for Hive Minded FEs	


◢ New Fallen Empire Homeworlds
Handcrafted homewords for fallen empires, each with its own narrative.
	[*] Celestial Dynamo -  Materialists
	[*] Eternal Citadel - Xenophobes
	[*] Ethereal Bastion - Xenophiles
	[*] Empyral Sanctuary - Spiritualists
	[*] Earth -  Xenophiles
	[*] Terran Wasteland -  Xenophobes
	[*] Undying Fortress - Militarists
	[*] Calescent Nest - Hivemind
Note: All FE Homeworlds can now be chosen as player starting systems.

◢ New Ethos Unique Systems
Special ethos-specific systems with specialties and rewards for those who captures them.
	[*] Necropolis of the Xenos
	[*] Antiquarian Tomb
	[*] Ancient Manufactory
	[*] Elysian Shrine	

◢ New Star Systems for Fallen Empires
Unique celestial formations unlike anything seen in Stellaris
	[*] Binary Stars - Two stars orbiting one another, each having their own family of planets
	[*] Brown Dwarfs - A supermassive gas giant with a plethora of orbiting planets
	[*] Trinary Stars - Three stars; two sharing a barycenter while orbiting the third, larger star	

◢ New Conditional Spawn system
Are you concerned of a Commonwealth of Man, United Nations of Earth, and now the addition of a fallen human empire breaking your immersion?
Fallen Empire Expanded pre-emptively checks the existence of Earth-based human empires (CoM or UNE) before spawning in a human fallen empire. 
There will only be one Sol in your galaxy.

http://i.imgur.com/wjQQrLw.png

Fallen Empire Expanded will be continuously updated and supported.
	• Guaranteed mod support for Stellaris 1.8 "Capek" at release
	• Continuous mod updates with new features

Past Mod Updates

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/815380349/1318835718936540253/]UPDATE 1.5 - September 12nd, 2017


[url=http://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/discussion/815380349/152393186500903214/]UPDATE 1.4 - Cancelled, unreleased

RELEASE 1.0 - December 9th, 2016

Fallen Empire Expanded is designed with mod compatibility in mind.

Design Philosophy of Fallen Empires Expanded
Fallen Empires Expanded is designed with maximum compatibility with other mods in mind. 

This mod...
	[*] Does not replace vanilla Stellaris files in any way
	[*] Does not modify entries or values in vanilla Stellaris files
	[*] Does not interfere or conflict with files added by other mods 
What is changed? - Direct replacement/alteration of vanilla files
	[*] Nothing

Compatibility with other mods

This submod for Gigastructural Engineering adds new systems centered around collecting and using stellar plasma to manipulate stars to a much higher degree than previously allowed

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tempest113/Steam-Image-Repo/refs/heads/main/Steam%20Embeds/Regular/Stellar%20Manipulation%201.png

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tempest113/Steam-Image-Repo/refs/heads/main/Steam%20Embeds/Regular/Stellar%20Manipulation%202.png

With a new ascension perk called Stellar Manipulation (requires Galactic Wonders, Star Lifters and Fusion Supressors) you can unlock a new megastructure that can be built around any standard star to change it's size, either harvest it for stellar plasma, reducing it's size in the process, or inject plasma to increase it.
Stars can be drained of almost all of their mass, leaving them as a Brown Dwarf, or they can be converted into their volatile, short lived big brother: the Class O Star.


https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tempest113/Steam-Image-Repo/refs/heads/main/Steam%20Embeds/Regular/Stellar%20Manipulation%203.png

Another mechanic added is Systemcraft assembly, after Lunar Macro-Fabricators and Behemoth Assembly Plants comes the systemcraft printer. Locked behind multiple Acension Perks and techs, the Systemcraft Assembler allows you to construct both regular Systemcraft and Class O Systemcraft in a single stage, assuming you can front the cost. Like other printed celestials, printed systemcraft cost more than their traditionally assembled counterparts but they make up for it with an increase in durability and firepower.


https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tempest113/Steam-Image-Repo/refs/heads/main/Steam%20Embeds/Regular/Stellar%20Manipulation%204.png

And last but not least is the Class O Systemcraft, which can either be built normally around a Class O Star, or it can be assembled at the aforementioned Systemcraft Assembler. With a reactor 5 times more powerful than that of the regular Systemcraft, the Class O Systemcraft can field 10 Existential Pseudo-Erasure Beams with plenty of power to spare (also comes with higher base stats, 30 more defensive slots and 3 more aux slots).

Class O Systemcraft are unlocked by possessing the "A celestial Armada" AP, the tech for the systemcraft final stage as well as the "Dyson Sphere Suprainsulation" tech.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/Tempest1273/myworkshopfiles]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tempest113/Steam-Image-Repo/refs/heads/main/Steam%20Embeds/Regular/My%20Other%20Mods%20Link.png

"My friends, you know me to be neither rash nor impulsive. I'm not given to wild, unsupported statements. And I tell you that we must evacuate this planet immediately!"
-- Jor-El, Superman: The Movie

Supernovae are among the most energetic events known to exist. This mod adds them to the Stellaris galaxy, so you can marvel at the destructive nature of the universe from a safe distance (or not).

When creating a new empire, you can choose to start in a star system that will go supernova in ten, thirty, fifty, or eighty years, with special events accompanying each stage of your sun's death throes. There are also three unique systems seeded across the galaxy which will go supernova at various points in the game, each of which can develop in different ways...

translations.description_clean:
Corrects combat behaviors to something more realistic.
Please test, review, and let me know how it works. I desperately need detailed feedback.

I do not actually play Stellaris, I only make mods. That is how I have fun. Since I do not actually play, I have no idea what would best for you. Please give me written feedback.

Compatibility
This addon has been endorsed by a frighteningly large number of the top addon authors on the workshop, including NSC, Realistic Ships, ASBM, and TFW's BOSP.

This mod is 100% compatible with all other mods. Not just the ones mentioned above.

It's a good companion mod to ASBM. This mod will fix any ship that does NOT use ASBMs behaviors. That includes the AI, and all ingame non-standard empires and ships. When you equip the "Non-AI" computer on your ships, it overrides this mod.

What's going on?
Some time ago I spent some effort [url=http://www.stellariswiki.com/Ship_modding]documenting the technical details of Stellaris' ship behavior.

It was during this endeavour that I realised whoever implemented the ship behavior changes for Stellaris 1.3 and later can not possibly be the same person who created the system initially. And whoever created it initially has not documented it for the new developers at Paradox.

Short and sweet; it's completely broken.

This mod represents (what I've concluded is) the least intrusive, most cross-mod compatible way to fix it.

[*]It is compatible with all addons.
[*]It fixes ship behaviors across any installed addon that adds ship types
[*]It has no user-facing interface or ingame representation, but works completely behind the scenes.


The mod is experimental, in the sense that I don't actually play the game that much. I merely make addons. As such, there's a limited set of scenarios I can test reliably.

The addon solves two major issues.

1. Ship targeting
Vanilla ships that equip Torpedoes, XL weapons, and some few others, will actually never attack non-vanilla (addon/mod) ships on purpose until all vanilla ships are dead.

There are obviously many scenarios where they will fire on non-vanilla ships, but at no point in a battle - while vanilla ships are alive - will these be their main target.

(Some addons "fix" this by overwriting the vanilla weapon files to add in their ship types as explicit targets. That sounds like a sustainable solution, right? I am not blaming them, it's obviously the solution Paradox intended - it's the solution they use themselves, after all. One issue with this is that only one installed mod can overwrite a vanilla file at a time. But that's not the only issue.)

Possibly the most obvious example of this is if you take a fleet of vanilla ships + Dreadnought from Realistic Ships to fight the Stellarite Devourer. It will simply never fire at the Dreads until the vanilla ships are dead. This is, as far as I have found, the best test scenario for this behavior. But it is - in fact - present in all fleet battles.

Another obvious example of completely broken behavior is the large Pirate Galleon that sometimes spawns. It will relentlessly kill your ships reliably in size order, from small to large. This is due to another issue than the one described above, but I've fixed this as well.

2. Movement fluidity
When vanilla fleets engage eachother, their movement is horrible and jagged. This can be fixed slightly by increasing formation scale and other tricks that NSC, ISB: Graphics, and other addons do. This mod makes it even smoother.

From limited testing it seems I can't make it smoother than what the addon currently does without overwriting more vanilla files that are commonly touched by other addons. But frankly this is not the main priority of the mod.


Behavior adjustments
Specifically, regarding combat targeting, here's the priorities this mod applies;

[*]Corvettes will charge into combat, focus any target they find, and when they see a large ship with all shields depleted, they charge and kill it
[*]Destroyers try to stay in the middle of the battle field, picking off low health targets
[*]Cruisers unleash their firepower on any ship not focused by Corvettes or Destroyers, mid-range, and try to help other ships finish off their targets
[*]Battleships stay in the back (but not as far back as vanilla), and fire on targets that no other ship is firing on. This results in them most of the time focusing the targets furthest away

As a player, what's worth knowing is that most addons (NSC, Realships, etc) that add ships already map (assign) their ships to one of these four behaviors. And if they do have their own behavior defined, which is exceptionally rare, this addon will not interfere with them at all.

Specifically, what did I do?
The problem is mostly to do with something Paradox calls component_target_weight_mult. Whenever a weapon (yes, all weapons pick their own targets) wants to pick a new target, it runs through a list of score bonuses and penalties. This list is extremely limited, and hard to work with. But in 1.3, Paradox added some new behavior (target_weight) to the XL and Torpedo slots that completely overrides this behavior, using component_target_weight_mult.

This addon prevents that entirely. Overriding their explicit-case override.
If you're an addon author, it means this mod makes ships ignore target_weights you set in your weapon components.

I could go on, but that seems like enough for now. Read the wiki, and my Aggro! computer addon code if you want to know more. I also wrote an article on the PDX forums that I have linked from my Aggro! workshop description.

Please let me know if you have any comments, questions, or suggestions.

Replaced files
The mod replaces the following game files:
common/ship_behaviors/00_strike_craft.txt
common/ship_behaviors/standard_ship_behaviors.txt

If some other mod overwrites these files before us (the first letter in their mod preceeds "A", for example "!" and "(")

translations.description_clean:
Discontinued/Out of Date
This mod was made when there were not many ways to increase district size and play tall... now vanilla has added plenty of options to do just that. I make mods that I want to play with in my own games, and I don't really feel the need for this one anymore. If anyone wants to take on the task of maintaining and updating this, you are welcome to.

Sky Islands and Subterranean Cities
Tired of mastering nature and thinking, all I got was two lousy districts? Well now you don't have to stop at flattening mountains and filling in the sea, you can create underground cities or even build islands in the sky.  These new decisions are more expensive, but they will give you far more than just a district or two, they come with unique jobs, event chains, and planet modifiers. The goal is to flush out one of the best perks in the game with more choices, trade offs, and depth.

Planet Decisions
Building a subterranean or floating city takes time. Starting a project takes upfront influence and energy, but mineral and alloy costs will be spread over the 5 years it takes to complete. Once you decree that a project will begin, an event screen allows you to choose what kind of sky island or subterranean city you have in mind. Each one offers both powerful bonuses and balancing maluses that will appear as a new planet modifier once construction is complete. 

Mastery of Nature
If you have the ascension perk, Sky Islands and Subterranean cities grant an extra district each. The perk also lets you repeated the decisions for additional jobs and districts (up to 9), for higher costs and diminishing returns. You only get the first Subterranean and Sky modifiers per planet however. The vanilla Mastery of Nature decision now grants +10% habitability instead of districts, since you can get plenty from the mod. 

Subterranean cities grant 1-3 districts based on larger planet sizes, with breakpoints at size 16, 20, and 24.They are slightly cheaper, but provide less jobs/pop. It is unlocked either by the ascension perk, or Mineral Isolation (Mining tech 3.) Sky Islands grant 1-3 districts based on smaller planet sizes with breakpoints at size 20, 16, and 12. (In lore this is due to lower gravity on smaller planets, but it is also a game balance mechanic) Sky Islands are unlocked by Anti-Gravity Engineering (Housing Tech 2) or the Mastery of Nature ascension perk.

Each decision has its own background and lore, and can trigger follow up event chains that may add additional bonuses or risks. The Subterranean Foundry event chain is the most extensive, with several possible outcomes. It is essentially a backend nerf to the over powered alloys modifier, so don’t worry if that seems too good to be true. It is. This is Fine.

translations.summary_zh_current: 为「自然主宰」飞升扩展天空岛与地下城建造：更昂贵但附带独特岗位、事件链与星球修正，已停止更新。
translations.description_zh_current: 本 MOD 已停止更新（作者认为原版已提供足够多的区划扩展手段）。内容回顾：为「自然主宰」（Mastery of Nature）飞升扩展两种新行星决策——天空岛与地下城。相比平山填海，这两种建造更昂贵（前期投入影响力与能量，矿物与合金成本分摊在 5 年建设期内），但收益远超一两个区划：附带独特岗位、事件链与星球修正。开工后会出现事件界面让你选择要建造的天空岛/地下城类型，每种都同时提供强力增益与平衡性减益，完成后以新星球修正呈现。持有自然主宰飞升时，天空岛与地下城额外提供一个区划。
translations.gameplay_zh_current: 持有「自然主宰」飞升后，通过行星决策开启天空岛/地下城项目，经事件选择类型，5 年后完成并获得对应增益/减益修正。注意已停止更新，仅适合旧版本或怀旧游玩。
translations.reviews_zh_current: 订阅 15890、收藏 4014。本模组作者已标注弃坑/过期：因原版现已有多种增加区划与高塔玩法的方式，作者自认为不再需要此模组，并表示若有人愿意接手维护更新欢迎接手。模组内容为扩展「自然主宰」相关玩法，新增天空岛与地下城决策，比原版决策更昂贵，但提供独特岗位、事件链与行星修正，并附带增益与平衡性惩罚。拥有自然主宰飞升时，天空岛与地下城额外提供区划，飞升允许重复决策以换取更多岗位与区划（上限 9 次、成本递增、收益递减）。
translations.features_zh_current: ["天空岛与地下城建造决策", "独特岗位与事件链", "完成后获得星球修正", "已停止更新，仅供旧版"]
